yaw.rationale: 3 ground-pivoted cranks plus2 separate pin-connected links: M=3(6-1)-2*7=1. Common pitch carrier adds one controlled DOF; no free translated-bar assumption.

gaze_convention: Positive mechanical yaw looks+X; positive mechanical pitch looks down(-Z). Gaze=[sin(yaw),-cos(yaw)cos(pitch),-cos(yaw)sin(pitch)]. Servo pulse signs calibrated separately.
limitations: Nominal rigid planar model; hole-axis alignment and measured horn radius required.
Does not validate printed pin clearance, fastener/tool access, friction, backlash, load, collisions or hardware fit.
A separate full geometry sweep is required.
